title: Japanese Tuna Salad
description: A refreshing and easy-to-make salad featuring juicy tuna, crunchy vegetables, and a hint of Japanese flavors.
instructions: Cut the sushi-grade tuna into small pieces.
Slice the cucumber and carrot into thin strips.
In a large bowl, combine the tuna, cucumber, carrot, and salad greens.
Drizzle the French dressing over the top and toss to combine.
Sprinkle the sesame seeds over the top.
If using salmon roe, sprinkle over the top and serve immediately.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
